question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
evidence: Final result should return the Team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier League refers to League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT teamInfo.team_long_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS __r FROM League AS leagueData INNER JOIN Match AS matchData ON leagueData.id = matchData.league_id INNER JOIN Team AS teamInfo ON matchData.away_team_api_id = teamInfo.team_api_id WHERE leagueData.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND matchData.season = '2009/2010' AND matchData.away_team_goal - matchData.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY matchData.away_team_api_id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT teamInfo.team_long_name FROM League AS leagueData INNER JOIN Match AS matchData ON leagueData.id = matchData.league_id INNER JOIN Team AS teamInfo ON matchData.away_team_api_id = teamInfo.team_api_id WHERE leagueData.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND matchData.season = '2009/2010' AND matchData.away_team_goal - matchData.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY matchData.away_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

c.sql: SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Match m2 JOIN League l2 ON m2.league_id = l2.id WHERE l2.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m2.season = '2009/2010' AND m2.away_team_goal > m2.home_team_goal GROUP BY m2.away_team_api_id))

b.request: Which away team in the Scotland Premier League (League.name = 'Scotland Premier League') had the most away wins (away_team_goal > home_team_goal) in the 2009/2010 season, returning Team.team_long_name, and returning all teams tied for the highest count of away wins?
b.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.team_long_name AS team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name) SELECT team_long_name FROM counts WHERE wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM counts)

d.request: In the Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most matches during the 2009/2010 season? If several teams are tied for the most away wins, return all of them. Return each team's `Team.team_long_name`.
d.sql: WITH wins AS (SELECT m.away_team_api_id AS team_id, COUNT(*) AS w FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id) SELECT t.team_long_name FROM wins JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = wins.team_id WHERE wins.w = (SELECT MAX(w) FROM wins)
